# Next Movie

> Free AI movie picker for families at nextmovie.app

## What is Next Movie?

Next Movie is a free AI-powered movie recommendation app built for families. It helps you decide what to watch in under 30 seconds. Each family member gets their own taste profile with age-appropriate content filters (G, PG, PG-13, R). The AI learns your preferences over time and gets smarter with every like and dislike.

## Key Features

- AI-powered movie and TV show recommendations
- Family profiles with individual taste learning
- Age-based content filters (G, PG, PG-13, R) per family member
- Mood-based search ("cozy rainy day movie", "funny but not dumb")
- 12 genre categories (Action, Comedy, Drama, Horror, Sci-Fi, Romance, Thriller, Animation, Documentary, Fantasy, Family, Mystery)
- Streaming availability (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Apple TV+, Crave, Hulu, and more)
- Family Swipe mode — everyone votes, the app picks the winner
- Works in 50+ countries with local streaming data
- Language filters: English, French, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, Kannada, Marathi, Punjabi, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Arabic, and more
- Actor and director search
- Personal watchlist
- No app download required — works in any browser on phone, tablet, or desktop

## Pricing

- Free: AI picks, genre browsing, age-safe filters, 2 family profiles
- Premium ($4.99/month, $49.99/year, or $99.99 lifetime): Language filters, actor/director search, streaming platform filter, unlimited profiles, watchlist, unlimited history, Family Swipe mode

## How it compares

- vs JustWatch: JustWatch shows where to stream but doesn't pick movies. Next Movie uses AI to suggest films based on taste, mood, and family ages, then shows where to stream.
- vs IMDb: IMDb is a database for looking up movies. Next Movie is a picker — you describe what you want and it finds matches filtered by age rating.
- vs Letterboxd: Letterboxd is a social film diary for enthusiasts. Next Movie is a family-first tool where each person has their own profile and the AI finds movies everyone agrees on.
- vs Taste.io: Both learn your taste from ratings. Next Movie adds family profiles, age filters, mood search, streaming links, and Family Swipe mode.
